description: Matplotlib visualization micro-cells. Each cell takes a DataFrame or array and produces a saved chart file. Covers the most common plot types used in data analysis.

Python_Core.code:
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
_fig, _ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
_num = {input_var}.select_dtypes(include='number')
_num.iloc[:, 0].plot(kind='bar', ax=_ax, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black')
_ax.set_title('Bar Chart')
_ax.set_xlabel({input_var}.index.name or 'Index')
_ax.set_ylabel(_num.columns[0])
plt.tight_layout()
_path = 'bar_chart.png'
plt.savefig(_path, dpi=150)
plt.close()
{output_var} = _path

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
_col = {input_var}.select_dtypes(include='number').columns[0]
_fig, _ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
_ax.hist({input_var}[_col].dropna(), bins=30, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
_ax.set_title(f'Distribution of {_col}')
_ax.set_xlabel(_col)
_ax.set_ylabel('Frequency')
plt.tight_layout()
_path = 'histogram.png'
plt.savefig(_path, dpi=150)
plt.close()
{output_var} = _path

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
_num = {input_var}.select_dtypes(include='number')
_x_col, _y_col = _num.columns[0], _num.columns[min(1, len(_num.columns)-1)]
_fig, _ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
_ax.scatter({input_var}[_x_col], {input_var}[_y_col], alpha=0.6, color='steelblue')
_ax.set_xlabel(_x_col)
_ax.set_ylabel(_y_col)
_ax.set_title(f'{_x_col} vs {_y_col}')
plt.tight_layout()
_path = 'scatter.png'
plt.savefig(_path, dpi=150)
plt.close()
{output_var} = _path

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
_fig, _ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 8))
_cax = _ax.imshow({input_var}.values, cmap='coolwarm', aspect='auto', vmin=-1, vmax=1)
plt.colorbar(_cax, ax=_ax)
_ax.set_xticks(range(len({input_var}.columns)))
_ax.set_xticklabels({input_var}.columns, rotation=45, ha='right')
_ax.set_yticks(range(len({input_var}.index)))
_ax.set_yticklabels({input_var}.index)
_ax.set_title('Correlation Heatmap')
plt.tight_layout()
_path = 'heatmap.png'
plt.savefig(_path, dpi=150)
plt.close()
{output_var} = _path

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
_cols = {input_var}.columns.tolist()
_label_col = _cols[0]
_value_col = _cols[-1] if len(_cols) > 1 else _cols[0]
_fig, _ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 8))
_ax.pie({input_var}[_value_col].head(10), labels={input_var}[_label_col].head(10), autopct='%1.1f%%')
_ax.set_title('Distribution')
plt.tight_layout()
_path = 'pie_chart.png'
plt.savefig(_path, dpi=150)
plt.close()
